verify_detail: accidentally) randomized flag in the sync stub, so the assertion is checking for a UI element whose presence is a coin flip rather than a stable app state.\n\n**Fix direction for the test team:** this isn\'t a timing/animation flake to wait out — the test needs either (a) the app to expose a deterministic way to force `skip=false` (a test hook / launch arg), or (b) the "Retry sync" assertion to branch on the "Sync unavailable" vs "Sync idle" state rather than assuming the button always renders.'
